HangmanPage.instructions: The aim of the game is to guess the word by successive letters attempts. Each attempt has the effect of indicating the places where the selected letter is inside the word or in case of failure, the completion of the figure in the hangers. If the figure has been drawn completely, the game is lost.
PheasantPage.instructions: The aim of the game is to form words that start with the last 2 letters of your opponent's word. If you cannot form a word, press the skip round button. In the end, the one who survives wins.
WordlePage.instructions: The aim of the game is to guess the word from a maximum of 6 attempts. When checking a word, the letters will be colored in: green (if the letter is in the word and in the correct position), yellow (if the letter is in the word, but not in the correct position) or gray (the letter is not in the word).
